[[Maw the Mountain Heart]], the giant and elusive [[Frost Wurm]] [[boss]], can be found randomly in many parts of the [[Southern Shiverpeaks]].

==Locations==
*[[Southern Shiverpeaks]]
**{{NPC location|Dreadnought's Drift}}, directly east from the [[Statue of Dwayna]].
**{{NPC location|Grenth's Footprint}}, at any of the boss spawn points.
**{{NPC location|Lornar's Pass}}, on the west side, on a path around the frozen lake (shared with a [[plant]] boss).
**{{NPC location|Mineral Springs}}, in the southeast area, south of the [[Tundra Giant]]s.
**{{NPC location|Snake Dance}}, at any of the boss spawn points.
**{{NPC location|Spearhead Peak}}, outside [[Granite Citadel]] and northwest of [[Copperhammer Mines]].
**{{NPC location|Talus Chute}}, in the area between [[Droknar's Forge]] and [[Ice Caves of Sorrow]].

==Skills==
16 [[Curses]]
*{{Skill icon|Feast of Corruption}} ([[elite]])
*{{Skill icon|Suffering}}

==Items dropped==
*[[Frozen Shell]]

==Notes==
*It consistently [[spawn]]s in [[Dreadnought's Drift]], but rarely in the other areas.
*This boss spawns randomly, so you may or may not encounter it at any of its designated locations above.
*While fighting this boss, it is wise to spread apart so you can avoid its [[Area of Effect|AoE]] spells.
*If you kill this boss while he is underground, for example by degeneration, he will not leave a corpse and thus you will not be able to capture his elite.

==Trivia==
*[[Cyndr the Mountain Heart]] is another Wurm with the same appellation.
* Maw's corpse could once be found as a [[gw2:Maw's Rise|point of interest]] in [[Guild Wars 2]], but was later removed as part of a [[gw2:Living_World_Season_1#The_Origins_of_Madness|living story update]].
